In this paper, we discuss the LCID selection for feature combination with the following observations: Observation 1: R18 Redcap and R18 coverage enhancements (Msg1 repetition) WIs both agreed to introduce a new feature in feature combination for RACH partitioning. Observation 2: R18 NTN/eRedcap/MUSIM intended to introduce new LCIDs for early identification in Msg3. And we propose: Proposal 1: RAN2 to discuss when there is dedicated Msg1 resource for (e)Redcap, whether to only include LCID associated to other feature in Msg3 in case of a feature combination (e.g., R18 eRedcap + R18 NTN). Proposal 2: RAN2 to discuss how to address the collision of LCID selection in Msg3 for a feature combination. R2-2309754, Discussion on CCCH LCID extension, CATT
